_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: one agent — a body with velocity

voltage.why: stigmergy as memory-in-the-environment — no neurons, no memory, just a chemical trace others read and rewrite; cognition offloaded to the world's surface
the flock as collective-without-leader — pheromone gradients coordinate foraging with no central plan; the optimum is a residue of many local rewrites, not a decision
emergence as the political — same 30 agents, three power structures (corporate convergence / ecological spread / artistic novelty); the landscape you impose is the politics the swarm obeys
separation vs cohesion as social tension made visible — belong-or-individuate crossing a phase transition; order emerges from local rules with no author (the political from the neighborhood)
